units.source_text: 春秋二季的诵经自不必说，此外源氏大将又常临时举行种种法会。

en.t: Needless to say, there were sutra readings in spring and autumn, and in addition General Genji often held various Buddhist services on special occasions.

units.source_text: 他还召集事简多暇的文章博士，

en.t: He also gathered professors of letters whose duties were light and who had plenty of leisure,

units.source_text: 和他们吟诗作文，或做掩韵游戏，藉以遣怀，一向不赴宫中。

en.t: and with them he recited poems, composed prose, or played games of hidden rhymes to ease his feelings, while never going to the palace.

units.source_text: 如此任情游乐，不问政事，又渐渐引起了世人的烦言。

en.t: This unrestrained pursuit of pleasure and disregard for affairs of government gradually stirred up criticism from the world once again.
